title: The Tarred Hold
intro_lines: A UTC tender lies keel-up on the reef shelf.
Its hold is sealed with tar and chain.
Tide-Puck whines at the dark water.

choices.label: Dive the hold before the tide turns

outcomes.text: You pry a crate free: hard tack, dry powder, good scrap.
A moray lunges from the hold. You surface bleeding.
The chain gives and the hold floods. You lose the crate.

choices.label: Send Tide-Puck to scent the hold

outcomes.text: Puck paws at a crate of UTC crystal shards. You take them.
Puck recoils, hackles up. You leave the hold alone.
A UTC patrol boat rounds the headland. You swim for rock.

choices.label: Mark it and sell the bearings at a haven

outcomes.text: A fence pays for the coordinates and asks nothing.
The buyer is UTC. He takes the bearings and your knife.
Word spreads that you found a hold and lost it.

history_note: Careening crews heeled ships on tidal beaches to scrape and tar hulls, and castaways salvaged wreck timber, lead and iron for reuse, as Tromelin's survivors did with salvaged lead basins.

title: Two Huts and a Goatskin Coat
intro_lines: Two huts of stone and sailcloth, roofless now.
A goatskin coat hangs on a peg, stiff with salt.
Something scratched tallies into the doorpost.

choices.label: Read the tally marks and the journal

outcomes.text: The journal names a freshwater seep and a goat run. You copy it.
The pages crumble. You save only a scrap of the chart.
You disturb a nest of centipedes in the bedding.

choices.label: Take the goatskin coat and the knife

outcomes.text: The coat is rank but warm. The knife still holds an edge.
The coat tears apart in your hands, rotten at the seams.
A rusted blade hidden in the sleeve opens your wrist.

choices.label: Dig beneath the sleeping hut

outcomes.text: A turtle shell of rainwater, still sealed with wax.
Only roots and rat bones. The cache was emptied long ago.
The pit collapses on your arm. You wrench it free.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk survived Juan Fernandez alone for four years and four months in goatskin clothes, taming feral cats and kid goats and keeping two huts, one to sleep in and one to cook.

title: The Cache Behind the Waterfall
intro_lines: Behind the waterfall, a dry shelf of black rock.
A chest of tarred hides, bound with green chain.
Tide-Puck sneezes at the mildew.

choices.label: Break the chain with iron and stone

outcomes.text: Inside: powder, coin and a pistol wrapped in oilcloth.
A decoy. The real cache lies under the flagstones.
The powder is damp, but the flask still burns your hands.

choices.label: Pry the lid with a knife and patience

outcomes.text: Coin, a chart, and a captain's written articles.
The lid splinters. You salvage only loose coin.
A spring trap snaps at your fingers.

choices.label: Leave it sealed and mark the cave

outcomes.text: You notch the rock and keep the place for a leaner season.
Someone came before you. The mark is already cut.
You trip on the chain and gash your shin on rock.

history_note: At Ile Sainte-Marie from 1690 Adam Baldridge traded cattle to careening crews for guns, powder and iron, and pirates scuttled ships to block the harbour mouth.

title: The Bottle in the Wrack
intro_lines: A green glass bottle rolls in with the weed.
Wax seal, a sailor's knot, a folded chart.
The ink has run, but the soundings hold.

choices.label: Follow the chart at first light

outcomes.text: It points to a sea cave that opens only at low tide.
You misread the run of the soundings and lose a day.

choices.label: Sell the chart to a passing crew

outcomes.text: A turtling crew pays in coin and a jar of water.
They laugh, take the chart, and leave you the bottle.
The crew is UTC. They note your face and your camp.

choices.label: Copy it, then burn the original

outcomes.text: You keep your copy and the bottle's wax for sealing.
The chart burns faster than you meant. Only half survives.

history_note: Castaways carved tallies and kept journals to hold their minds together, and Selkirk read aloud from the Bible to keep his speech.

title: The Cave That Breathes
intro_lines: The sea cave breathes: in with the swell, out again.
A ledge of dry crates above the waterline.
UTC marks stencilled on every lid.

choices.label: Crack a crate and take the manifest

outcomes.text: A ledger lists crystal crates and the buyer's name.
The crate holds chain and shackles, not cargo.
A swell lifts you into the rock. The manifest is lost.

choices.label: Wait in the dark for whoever owns this

outcomes.text: Boots on stone. A lone figure enters, unarmed.
Two voices, arguing in Tideborn. You slip out unseen.
A lantern sweeps the ledge. You hold your breath an hour.

choices.label: Roll a tar barrel into the channel

outcomes.text: It sinks in the channel and draws eyes. You take the small crates.
The barrel lodges and bobs. You abandon it and swim.
The noise carries. A horn sounds somewhere above.

history_note: Captured masters were pressed into service to identify the richest prizes, and prize cargoes were recorded in ledgers before division.

title: The Scribe in Grey Rags
intro_lines: She wears UTC grey cut down to rags.
Tideborn ink on her wrists, half-scrubbed.
She sets down a knife, blade toward herself.

choices.label: Share your water and hear her out

outcomes.text: She was the ledger's scribe. She names the crystal buyer.
She drinks, then asks the way to your camp.
The water was drugged. You wake stripped of your haul.

choices.label: Take her knife and tie her down

outcomes.text: She talks fast: crystals, a buyer, a rendezvous.
She twists free and puts the blade in your shoulder.
You cannot do it. She spits, names you coward, and is gone.

choices.label: Kill her and take the ledger

outcomes.text: It is quick. The ledger is yours, and so is the weight of it.
She is faster than she looks and marks your arm badly.
Her scout whistle brings answers from the cliff top.

choices.label: Walk away and let her keep the cave

outcomes.text: You leave her the crates. She calls a warning after you.
Halfway down the cliff you hear the crates being broken open.

history_note: Archaeologists at Tromelin found tools carefully stored and repaired, signs the castaways planned for a long stay.

title: The Arch That Wakes in Rain
intro_lines: An arch of black coral, half-swallowed by figs.
The carvings only show when the stone is wet.
Something watches from the fern line.

choices.label: Trace the wet inscriptions

outcomes.text: The marks warm and answer: a path, a warning, a name.
The stone cuts you and the faint light dies.
A scout steps from the ferns, spear low, and studies your hands.

choices.label: Copy the carvings onto sailcloth

outcomes.text: Charcoal and cloth: a rubbing worth more than coin.
The rain smears it all to grey pulp.
The scout takes the cloth and leaves you the charcoal.

choices.label: Leave an offering at the arch foot

outcomes.text: The pearl is taken. A hand-shaped mark is left in thanks.
Nothing comes. The pearl sits there, mocking you.
Coconut crabs drag the pearl into the dark.

choices.label: Break off a carved stone and run

outcomes.text: The stone is heavy and faintly humming. You get clear.
The arch groans and falling coral breaks your shoulder.
The scout is faster. You drop the stone and flee.

history_note: Tromelin's castaways built walls 1.5 m thick from coral and beachrock with their backs to the trade wind, and such masonry outlasts the builders.

title: The Careening That Never Finished
intro_lines: A hull lies heeled on the slope, ribs to the sky.
Tar pots, a dead fire, a battery of spiked guns.
The teredo worm has done its work.

choices.label: Strip the hull for timber and iron

outcomes.text: Good oak ribs, iron bolts, and a pot of tar still soft.
The hull shifts on the slope. You jump clear, barely.
The crew's ghosts are only crabs. One takes your thumb.

choices.label: Fire the beach battery at a passing sail

outcomes.text: The shot falls short, but the sail changes course away.
A gun bursts its breech. Splinters open your cheek.
The sail answers with a ranging shot. You scatter.

choices.label: Search the tents and the dead fire

outcomes.text: Written articles, a tally stick, and rum still sealed.
Rats have been here. Only bone and wet powder.
A boar has claimed the camp and charges from the tent.

history_note: Pirate crews careened on sloping beaches at high tide, landed their guns in a beach battery, and were defenceless while the hull was scraped.

title: Red Hands, Cold Water
intro_lines: Cold air breathes from a crack in the cliff.
Hand stencils in red ochre, older than the trees.
A seep of water darkens the far wall.

choices.label: Dig out the seep behind the dune line

outcomes.text: Brackish, then sweet: a freshwater lens, thin but true.
The hole fills with sand and salt water.
The roof shifts. Grit and stone come down on you.

choices.label: Study the paintings by torchlight

outcomes.text: Boats, a serpent of lights, a hand holding a shard.
Your smoke blackens the ochre. You have ruined it.
Bats burst from the roof and beat out your torch.

choices.label: Camp in the mouth and rest out the heat

outcomes.text: Shade, cool air, sleep without sun. You wake clear-headed.
Centipedes in the bedding. Your arm swells hot.
You wake to a crab dragging off your rations.

history_note: Castaways found brackish water by digging behind the dune line and caught rain in shells and salvaged basins, as Serrano did with his shells.

title: What the Boobies Stole
intro_lines: A booby nest of stolen rope and fish bones.
Under it: a tarred coat and a brass chart case.
The owner is a skeleton on the rocks below.

choices.label: Climb down for the chart case

outcomes.text: A fragment: soundings, a marked cay, a date.
The rock gives. You slide the last two fathoms.
The case holds only sand and a dead beetle.

choices.label: Take the eggs and leave the dead man be

outcomes.text: Three eggs, warm, and a nest of dry fibre for tinder.
The colony rises screaming and strikes your head.
The eggs are addled and stink. You gag and drop them.

choices.label: Bury the sailor and read his coat

outcomes.text: Stitched in the lining: a name, a ship, a share of a prize.
The coat crumbles. You bury him with a shell for a marker.
A knife in the lining opens your palm to the bone.

history_note: Seabird colonies on tropical cays supplied eggs and meat to castaways, and nests were lined with whatever fibre and salvage the birds could steal.

title: The Neighbour Who Left in a Hurry
intro_lines: A neighbour's outpost, gate open, fire gone to ash.
Pallets split, water butt tipped out.
Someone left in a hurry, or was taken.

choices.label: Search the wreck of the camp

outcomes.text: Stores the raiders missed: rope, tar, a sealed keg.
A trip-line snaps and a spiked plank takes your calf.
The owner returns with friends and does not believe you.

choices.label: Mend the gate and leave water

outcomes.text: You fix the hinge and leave a full shell. Word will travel.
The owner's dog is still here, half-starved, and bites.
You work too long. A UTC patrol crests the ridge.

choices.label: Salvage the palisade and go

outcomes.text: Good stakes and rope, taken in the dark.
A bell-wire runs to a powder charge. You cut it in time.
The owner's lookout saw you. A horn sounds inland.

history_note: Archaeologists at Tromelin found tools carefully stored and repaired, signs the castaways planned for a long stay.

title: Powder Cache in the Dunes
intro_lines: Tide-Puck digs frantically at a sand ridge.
A rusted flintlock mechanism protrudes from the lid.

choices.label: Disarm the trigger carefully

outcomes.text: The catch releases cleanly. Twenty pounds of dry powder and a bag of shot are yours.
A spring snaps. Flash-burn sears your hands, but the powder survives.
The barrel detonates. Shrapnel tears your side; powder lost to the wind.

choices.label: Smash it open from a distance

outcomes.text: A rock from twenty paces splits the stave. Half the powder dampens in sand.
Impact fires the trap. Blast hurls sand and splinters; you keep your fingers.

history_note: Pirates cached powder in sealed barrels on careening beaches; Selkirk found Spanish stores on Juan Fernández but dared not touch unfamiliar mechanisms.

title: The Drowning Grotto
intro_lines: A sea cave yawns at low tide.
Water already laps the entrance.

choices.label: Swim deep for the relic glint

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck herds you through a chimney to an air pocket. A Tideborn idol rests on a ledge.
Current slams you into barnacles. The relic slips deeper; you surface bleeding.
Roof collapses behind you. Trapped in darkness until ebb — hours of cold terror.

choices.label: Anchor a line and probe the shallows

outcomes.text: Grappling hook snags a corroded chest. Salt-eaten charts and a silvered spyglass inside.
Line parts on razor coral. Chest stays; you haul back only frayed fibres.

history_note: Serrano on Serrana Bank dove for fire stones in flooded caves; Tromelin castaways timed reef crossings by the moon to avoid drowning.

title: Collapsed Guano Mine
intro_lines: Timbers groan beneath a cliff overhang — a guano mine.
A shaft yawns, blocked by a fall of coral rag and rusted

choices.label: Clear the fall with pick and sweat

outcomes.text: Two days' labour opens a crawlspace. Crystalline nitrate crusts the walls — pure fertiliser and bomb-stuff.
Secondary collapse pins your leg. Tide-Puck fetches help; you lose a day and the iron pick.
Bad air — hydrogen sulphide. You stagger out vomiting, pick abandoned in the dark.

choices.label: Lower Tide-Puck to scout first

outcomes.text: Companion returns with a chunk of nitrate and a warning: deeper shafts flooded, unstable.
Puck doesn't return. Frantic digging finds him shaken but alive beside a nest of sea kraits.

history_note: Guano mining on Pacific islands used convict labour; collapses and toxic gas killed many — Tromelin's castaways avoided the island's lone shaft for this reason.

title: The Weeping Spring
intro_lines: Rain unveils a curtain of water seeping from a limestone
But monkey chatter echoes above; something watches the pool.

choices.label: Drink deep and fill every vessel

outcomes.text: Sweet water revives you. Barrels full, throat clear — the best find since landfall.
Macaques drop fruit — then stones. One cracks your shoulder; you retreat half-empty.
A krait drops from the ferns into the pool. You flee, bottles abandoned.

choices.label: Build a bamboo pipeline to camp

outcomes.text: Gravity does the work. Clean water flows to your kettle day and night.
Joints leak; half the flow soaks into jungle mud before it reaches you.

choices.label: Poison the pool to kill the watchers

outcomes.text: Macaques convulse and die. Water fouled — undrinkable for weeks. A waste.
Troop flees, but elders warn the Tideborn. Scouts mark your camp as dangerous.

history_note: Macaque troops raid camps for food and give alarm calls when predators approach.

title: Careening Cove Hidden by Mangroves
intro_lines: A narrow channel behind mangrove roots opens onto a sloping
Old tar pots and a shattered capstan lie half-buried.
Someone cared for hulls here.

choices.label: Careen your vessel now, tide permitting

outcomes.text: Tide lifts, you heel, scrape worm-tunnels clean, re-tar the bottom. Speed restored.
Spring tide surges early. Ship slides off blocks, crushes a gunport. Costly repair.
UTC cutter spots the mast tops. You cut anchor and run, hull half-scraped.

choices.label: Fortify the cove as a hidden base

outcomes.text: Palisade and a concealed boom. Now you can careen, repair, and vanish in hours.
Free pirates find your work. They claim half the cove — or they'll burn it.

history_note: Pirates chose island haunts for careening beaches — Sainte-Marie's bay held scuttled ships as barriers; teredo worm ate hulls in weeks without tarring.

title: The Crow's Nest Ridge
intro_lines: A razorback ridge climbs above the tree line.
Wind tears at your clothes.
From here, the whole atoll lies spread — channels, wrecks.

choices.label: Build a permanent lookout platform

outcomes.text: Platform lashed to banyan roots. You spot a UTC convoy two days out — warning bought.
Lightning strikes the mast. Platform burns; you descend singed but wiser.

choices.label: Sketch a detailed chart of the lagoon

outcomes.text: Ink and memory chart every coral head, every channel. Navigation grows safer.
Wind tears the parchment. You salvage fragments, but the whole picture is lost.

choices.label: Light a signal fire for passing ships

outcomes.text: A free pirate sloop sees the smoke. They trade powder for turtle and gossip.
UTC frigate logs the fire. A cutter arrives at dawn — they question, then leave.
No one comes. Fuel wasted. The ridge stays lonely.

history_note: Pirate lookouts on headlands gave hours of warning — Roberts at Tobago saw HMS Swallow's topsails and slipped away; Serrano's smoke signals were ignored by ships fearing shoals.

title: Ruined Battery of the Old Company
intro_lines: Fog clings to a stone embrasure.
Four carriage-guns point seaward, breeches spiked.
A powder magazine yawns behind, door rusted but sealed.

choices.label: Drill the spikes and remount the guns

outcomes.text: Iron drills bite. Two guns roar again — your cove now has teeth.
Drill snaps in a breech. One gun salvageable; the others stay spiked.
Spark hits residue. Magazine vents — concussion deafens you for days.

choices.label: Break the magazine seal for powder

outcomes.text: Keystone lifts. Barrels intact — forty pounds of serviceable grain powder.
Damp ate the cakes. Crumbling dust — useless for guns, fair for blasting.

history_note: Pirates landed guns in beach batteries while careening — Roberts at Ouidah; UTC forts on the Guinea coast mounted spiked guns to deny them to rivals.

title: Midnight Mangrove Betrayal
intro_lines: The bent mangrove looms in moonlight.
The pilot waits — but UTC cutters glide behind him.
He raised the alarm. Your kindness bought a trap.

choices.label: Fight through the ambush

outcomes.text: Musket and cutlass clear a path. The pilot dies cursing; you seize his officer's commission.
Too many. You swim the channel, gear lost. The cache stays hidden.

choices.label: Vanish into the roots like a crab

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck finds a submerged tunnel. You surface miles away, shaken but free.
Mud sucks at your boots. A marine's bayonet finds your thigh before you slip free.

history_note: Pirates were betrayed by recruits — Roberts' men deserted to the Navy; UTC used dark-binding crystals to turn Tideborn against each other.

title: Midnight Mangrove Redemption
intro_lines: The bent mangrove.
The pilot waits alone, chart spread on a root.
'You came. Good.'

choices.label: Take the cache and his knowledge

outcomes.text: He hands over everything. 'The Sovereign hunts UTC crystals. Destroy them, you survive.'
A crocodile lunges from the dark. He shoves you aside, takes the bite. Dies in your arms.

choices.label: Demand he guide you to the UTC crystal

outcomes.text: He agrees. Three nights later you burn a crystal store — the Sovereign screams in the deep.
Patrol catches you at the depot. He cuts your bonds, fights beside you — both escape bloody.

history_note: Ada Blackjack nursed a dying man alone; Selkirk's companionship with tamed goats and cats preserved his mind — mercy can forge alliances in isolation.

title: Coconut Crab Midden
intro_lines: Moonlight reveals a carpet of claws clicking.
Their midden glints: stolen cutlery, a compass.

choices.label: Wade in with a net and sack

outcomes.text: Sack full of meat and the amulet. Claws shred your boots but the prize is worth it.
A giant male severs a tendon. You limp away with only meat.
Swarm overwhelms. You flee, sack lost, boots gone.

choices.label: Bait a trap and wait till dawn

outcomes.text: Dawn finds the trap heavy. Meat, a spyglass, and the amulet — no blood spilled.
Monkeys raid the trap. You recover only scattered shell.

history_note: Coconut crabs steal shiny objects and migrate en masse; Selkirk ate them on Juan Fernández; Tromelin castaways gathered reef crustaceans by torchlight.

title: Hollow Camp
intro_lines: A lean-to of patched sailcloth flaps in the wind.
Cold ash in the fire pit.
No footprints lead away.

choices.label: Search the debris

outcomes.text: Find a waterlogged journal and usable supplies.
Rats have chewed everything. Only scraps remain.
A trap snaps shut on your ankle — someone meant to return.

choices.label: Burn it clean and move on

outcomes.text: Fire consumes the camp. No traces left for others.
Flare-up draws a UTC patrol from the headland.

history_note: Alexander Selkirk built two huts on Juan Fernández — one to sleep, one to cook — and hid from Spanish ships that would have enslaved him.

title: Causeway of Whispers
intro_lines: Low tide reveals a spine of basalt arches across
Bioluminescent algae pulse in the joints — Tideborn work.

choices.label: Cross carefully at slack water

outcomes.text: Reach the far isle. Find a tide-pool shrine with offerings.
A wave catches your boots. Current drags you — Tide-Puck pulls you free.
UTC divers surface beneath the arches. They spot you.

choices.label: Harvest humming algae for lanterns

outcomes.text: Fill shells with living light. Useful in caves.
Algae dies on contact. The arches dim slightly.
A Tideborn scout watches from the reef. Silent judgment.

history_note: Tromelin castaways built 1.5 m thick coral walls with backs to the trade wind; the sea reclaims what people build.

title: Iron Coffin at the Reef
intro_lines: Lightning silhouettes a UTC sloop's mast.
Dark-binding crystals still hum in the hold.

choices.label: Dive the wreck at dawn

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck guides you through shattered hull. Salvage iron and a log.
Crystal shard cuts your palm. Blood clouds water — reef sharks circle.
The sloop's magazine detonates. Concussion ruptures your eardrums.

choices.label: Tow the hull to your cove for breaking

outcomes.text: Winch it ashore over days. A fortune in iron and tar.
Towline snaps. Hull slides back into deep — and takes your boat.

choices.label: Mark it on your chart and warn others

outcomes.text: Free pirates salute the warning. UTC curses your name.
A UTC cutter finds your marker first. They ambush the next visitor.

history_note: UTC deploys dark-binding crystals that enrage the Abyssal Sovereign; the leviathan broke both Mythos Wake and the UTC warship in the storm.

title: Buried Trade Cache
intro_lines: An X carved into a kapok tree.
Tide-Puck digs frantically.
A rusted strongbox surfaces, barnacled but sealed.

choices.label: Pry it open with a crowbar

outcomes.text: Salted pork, rum, and a UTC officer's signet ring.
Powder keg inside — damp fuse. One spark and it's over.
Trap triggers. Poison needle in the latch. Fever takes hold.

choices.label: Rebury it and watch for claimants

outcomes.text: Two free pirates dig it up at dusk. You follow them home.
UTC landing party recovers it. They burn your marker tree.

history_note: Archaeologists at Tromelin found tools carefully stored and repaired, signs the castaways planned for a long stay.

title: Signpost of the Marooned
intro_lines: A driftwood post driven deep.
Carved arrows point three ways.
"WATER 200 PACES" — "CAREENING BEACH" — "UTC WATCHTOWER".

choices.label: Follow the water arrow

outcomes.text: A seep behind the dune line. Brackish but drinkable.
The pool is a manchineel sump. Blisters bloom on your hands.

choices.label: Scout the careening beach

outcomes.text: A grounded sloop, half-scraped. Tools left in the sand.
Pirates return early. They're not pleased you found their spot.
The beach is a graveyard. Teredo worms ate the hulls whole.

choices.label: Check the UTC watchtower

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck slips past sentries. Steal a signal codebook.
Spotlight sweeps the jungle. You freeze until it passes.
A crystal-tipped bolt pins your sleeve to a trunk. Close call.

history_note: Pedro Serrano used shells as rain catchers on Serrana Bank; ships ignored his smoke for fear of shoals — signposts save lives when read right.

title: Ruined Careening Camp
intro_lines: Blackened sand where tar kettles boiled.
A keel's ghost imprint remains.
Broken cutlasses and a surgeon's saw half-buried

choices.label: Sift the ash for metal

outcomes.text: Recover nails, hinges, an intact grappling hook.
Hot ember burns through your boot. Limp for days.
A boar rooting in the ash charges. Tusks tear your thigh.

choices.label: Read the surgeon's scattered notes

outcomes.text: Ciguatera cure: small reef fish only. Avoid barracuda.
Pages crumble. Only a sketch of the leviathan's crystal weakness remains.

choices.label: Build your own careening cradle here

outcomes.text: Solid ground, good slope. Your hull will be clean and fast.
Spring tide higher than expected. Cradle washes out. Materials lost.

history_note: Careening crews grounded ships at high tide on sloping beaches, heeled them over, scraped teredo worm and weed, then coated hulls with tar, tallow, and turtle fat.

title: Message in a Black Bottle
intro_lines: A sealed UTC bottle washes up.
Wax stamp unbroken.
Inside: coordinates and a single word — "RUN".

choices.label: Decode the coordinates

outcomes.text: Points to a UTC black site. Prisoners. Tideborn. Experiments.
Coordinates are a trap. UTC ambush waits at the location.
The bottle explodes — dark-binding crystal shard inside.

choices.label: Deliver it to Quartermaster Silas

outcomes.text: Silas reads the cipher. "Old shipmate's hand. He's alive."
Silas burns it. "Some messages are curses. We stay hidden."

history_note: Ada Blackjack kept a diary on Wrangel Island; writing preserved her mind when three men walked off over ice and never returned.

title: Sunken Shrine in the Blue Hole
intro_lines: A cenote opens in the reef floor.
Tide-Puck refuses the edge.
Down, down — Tideborn arches hum in the dark water.

choices.label: Dive with weighted line

outcomes.text: Touch the central altar. A vision: the Sovereign's true name.
Pressure ruptures your sinuses. Blood in the water. Eels come.
A Tideborn guardian blocks the ascent. You leave the pearl.

choices.label: Lower Tide-Puck in a harness

outcomes.text: He returns with a crystal fragment pulsing in his jaws.
He surfaces shaking. The depths changed him. Eyes hum faint.

history_note: Tromelin castaways kept one fire alive for 15 years with wreck timber and the island's single shrub; some sacred fires must not go out.

title: The Stranger at the Fire
intro_lines: A figure sits at your fire's edge.
No boat on the horizon.
Salt-crusted coat.

choices.label: Share meat and rum. Ask his name.

outcomes.text: "Call me Kestrel. Sailed with Roberts. I know where the gold went."
He eats, drinks, and vanishes before dawn. Only a map fragment remains.

choices.label: Hold him at blade-point. Search

outcomes.text: Find a UTC cipher and a Tideborn totem. He smiles. "Both sides pay."
He's faster. Blade at your throat. "Easy. I'm leaving." Gone.
His pack explodes — dark-binding crystal. He laughs as you burn.

choices.label: Wake the camp. Let the quartermaster

outcomes.text: Silas knows him. "Kestrel. Thought you hanged at Nassau." Tense reunion.
No one knows him. He slips away in the confusion.

history_note: Bartholomew Roberts' articles: quarrels settled ashore by pistol then cutlass, first blood wins; deserters gave intelligence to enemies.

title: Kestrel's Ledger — The Betrayal
intro_lines: Kestrel leads you to a cliffside cave.
"The cache.
Half yours." Inside: chests spilling coin, relics.

choices.label: Draw on him. You knew the price.

outcomes.text: Your blade finds his heart. The mirror shatters. Loot is yours.
He anticipated it. Poison dart. You collapse as UTC boats land.

choices.label: Feign trust. Signal Tide-Puck

outcomes.text: Rocks bury him and the mirror. You escape with what you carry.
He sees the signal. Slashes Tide-Puck. You flee, leaving the lot.

history_note: Pirate justice: defrauding the company meant marooning with a gun, shot, bottle of water, bottle of powder; betrayal was paid in blood.

title: Kestrel's Ledger — The Debt Paid
intro_lines: Kestrel rows you to a sea cave at storm's height.
"The ledger's here."
Water rises. He hands you a key. "For the chest.

choices.label: Take the key. Swim for it.

outcomes.text: Tide-Puck tows you through the surge. Chest holds a Tideborn navigational chart.
A timber crushes Kestrel. He shoves you clear. "Go. Tell Silas..."

choices.label: Refuse to leave him. Fight the water

outcomes.text: You haul each other out. The chest is lost. He owes you a life.
The roof collapses. You survive. He doesn't. His last breath: coordinates.
Both trapped. Tide-Puck finds Silas in time. Rescue comes at cost.

history_note: Pedro Serrano and a second castaway quarrelled then reconciled on Serrana Bank; survival forged bonds that betrayal could not buy.
